Seven studios compete for Dayton's dance students. None has finished the work AI search now rewards.

We audited 7 dance and ballroom studios serving the Dayton market head to head: site quality, Google's local results, and 6 live checks across ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI. The sites range from 61 to 83. The AI engines name only four of the 7. The field averages 63 (D) on AI readiness, 7 of 7 have no FAQ or Q&A structured data, and 4 of 7 have no llms.txt file. Whichever studio closes that gap first changes the answer for everyone searching this market.

Prepared by SiteTradeIn · Market snapshot generated 4 Oct 2026 · Independent audit — not commissioned by any studio in the field · See the ranked list

About this report

This is a market-wide snapshot, not an audit of a single business. We picked one competitive local market — dance and ballroom instruction in the Dayton, OH area — and ran the same measurement against every studio that competes for it: an automated site-quality grade across seven categories, where each studio shows up in Google's local results, and 6 live checks asking three AI engines who they'd recommend for two real buyer queries. Every studio named below is graded on identical criteria, on the same day, with no advance notice.

The point isn't to single any one studio out — it's to show what an AI-search-era competitive landscape actually looks like once you measure it instead of guessing at it. If your studio is one of the 7 below, this is where you stand today.

What the field shows

  • Arthur Murray Dance Center of Dayton (83) and Wedding Dances by Marquessa (76) lead on site quality, and the field runs down to 61. Every one of the top five still carries at least one D or F category.
  • No studio earns an A for AI readiness. The field averages 63 (D) on the category that decides whether an AI engine can read, trust and quote a site; the best score in the market is 77.
  • None of the 7 studios has FAQ or Q&A structured data, and 4 have no llms.txt file — the two cheapest AI-answer signals available. No studio in the market has both.
  • Two of the 7 are franchise locations (one Arthur Murray and one Fred Astaire); the rest are independent studios.
  • One site in the field still isn't served over HTTPS — a critical flag browsers show visitors before they see a single class schedule.
  • The gap between #1 and #7 is 22 points on identical criteria. Nothing in the scorecard requires a rebuild or a rebrand to close it — just the work.

Three of the 7 studios are never named on any of the 6 checks: Wedding Dances by Marquessa, Fred Astaire Dance Studios Kettering, RJBallroom. For a studio not doing this work, that's the default outcome — not a penalty, just the result of nobody in that seat having claimed it yet.

What separates the winners from the rest

  • Off-site proof, not just on-site polish. AI answers draw on what other sites say about a studio, not just on its own pages, so reviews, directory listings and a complete Google profile carry real weight.
  • Being unmistakably “in Dayton.” Studios that serve Dayton from nearby towns need pages, profiles and listings that say so in the words people search.
  • A complete, specific site. The strongest sites have no missing H1s or meta descriptions, alt text on their images, and schema that describes what the studio actually is.
  • Content matched to how people actually ask. The broad question and the ballroom question pull from different result sets — a studio needs to answer both.

The monthly SEO / AEO program

Every monthRe-measure all 3 engines, both queries, and the mapAI answers shift; a competitor closing this gap first changes the answer for everyone else.

Methodology & notes

Field (7 studios): arthurmurraydayton.com, weddingdancesbymarquessa.com, fredastaire.com/kettering, eleganceindance.biz, rjballroom.com, vkballroom.com, dayton-dance-center.com. Chosen from live Google searches on 4 Oct 2026: every adult ballroom, Latin or partner-dance studio with a working website that appeared in Google's local results for Dayton dance searches. Google's salsa search for Dayton returned a single listing with no website, so the salsa column is empty. Ohio Ballroom Studios (Franklin) also shows up in these searches; it's ranked on the Cincinnati page. Left out: The Ballroom Tutor, an independent coach who teaches out of Elegance In Dance's address (Google AI named it), the Dayton Ballroom Dance Club (a social dance club, named by ChatGPT), dance halls and societies (Michael Solomon Pavilion, Arbor Hall, Dayton Vintage Dance), DaytOn1 Salsa (Facebook page only), youth and competition studios (Special Touch Talent, Dance Expressions, Legacy Dayton, Funk Lab, Dayton Dance Conservatory, South Dayton School of Dance), and The Slink Room (pole).

Site audit: the same SiteTradeIn engine run for every studio on 4 Oct 2026, up to six pages per site, seven categories. Franchise locations that live on a national website (Fred Astaire) share that site's robots.txt, llms.txt, sitemap and templates.

AI visibility: 6 live checks — ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI, each asked “What are the best dance studios in Dayton, OH?” and “What are the best ballroom dance studios in Dayton, OH?” with a request for a top-five numbered list. Rankings are taken from each engine's own list; presence was confirmed by reading the raw response text, and every franchise mention was matched to its location. Each question was asked in a fresh session of each engine's public web app (ChatGPT logged out, Gemini in a temporary chat, Google's AI Mode), not through a developer API.

Google: local (Places) and first-page organic results captured in a live browser session on 4 Oct 2026 for “ballroom dance lessons dayton oh”; “dance lessons dayton oh”; “salsa lessons dayton oh”; “wedding dance lessons dayton oh”; “ballroom dance lessons kettering oh”, plus the organic searches “best dance studios in dayton oh” and “ballroom dance studio dayton”. Each query named the city; results vary by searcher location and over time.

Independence. This report is a market-wide measurement, not commissioned by or customized for any single studio named in it.

Limits. AI answers and search results vary between runs and over time; these are a point-in-time sample, not a fixed ranking.
